description:
Folding Electric Mini Bike
The DJ Mini Bike is as much fun to own as it is to ride. We combined the portability of a folding electric bike with an easy, step through frame to make this ebike as easy to use as it is to store. This easy step thru fat tire ebike goes almost everywhere with 20" puncture resistant fat tires and a powerful 250W motor with 5 levels of pedal assist and thumb throttle for power on demand. The powerful, 36V battery can be dismounted and charged anywhere on the go.
This step through folding electric bike, by DJ Bikes in Canada, is designed to perform perfectly touring the countryside, commuting through the city or on light off-road trails. And it’s loaded with extras – front and back fenders, robust storage rack with integrated taillight and front headlight and suspension to absorb shocks and is built to last with high-quality components.
The DJ Mini is powerful, affordable and made for everyone – a DJ Bikes favorite!
